name: Talaan
notes: Talaan V2.3.0 adds local OFX bank and credit-card plus QIF bank, cash, credit-card, asset, and liability statement parsing to the existing CSV import center. Format-aware preview, PHP currency gates, duplicate reasons, rule suggestions, recovery snapshots, Undo, and single-import rollback remain local-first. Finance Schema 12, Cloud Schema V3, account balances, Account Ledger entries, paid-state calculations, recurrence, project payments, encryption, backups, and synchronization semantics are preserved.
